ignoreValues.reason: Askama template: the avatar is wrapped in {% if avatar != "" %} so it never renders with an empty src. The detector cannot evaluate template conditionals. The tag must stay an because tests/authed_api.rs asserts the URL appears in the body.
Specular bloom inside the .silver material, not a palette colour. DESIGN.md records the material as ramp + bloom + planished dimpling + noise tooth; these alpha layers ARE the bloom and dimples.
Planishing dimple highlight inside the .silver material. See DESIGN.md's material description; not a palette entry.
Planishing dimple shadow inside the .silver material. See DESIGN.md's material description; not a palette entry.

The QR's pinned ground (.qr-plate/.qr-frame). DESIGN.md's Pinned Ink Rule requires the code stay black-on-white in BOTH renditions because a light-on-dark QR fails on many scanners. Being outside the palette is the whole point; palette tokens here would break scanning.
The QR's pinned ink (.qr-plate/.qr-frame). Same Pinned Ink Rule: deliberately outside the palette so the code never follows the rendition.
Upper bound of a clamp() on .address, not a ramp step. Fluid display type is bounded, not stepped; the documented ramp governs fixed sizes.
Lower bound of a clamp() on .preview-link, not a ramp step. Same reason as 30px.
Upper bound of a clamp() on .preview-link, not a ramp step. Same reason as 30px.
